evals.name: project-parcel-directory
evals.prompt: Project ParcelCollected and ParcelWithdrawn into a keyed parcel directory.
evals.expected_output: Model-bound create and remove mapping with two-source evidence.
assertions: Keys rows by parcel identity rather than label.
After withdrawal the addressed key is absent and the control row is unchanged.

evals.name: select-materialized-sink
evals.prompt: A passive fold works but the list endpoint enumerating MongoDB is empty. Diagnose the storage choice.
assertions: Selects a materialized model for enumeration.
Does not claim a successful passive fold populated MongoDB.
Checks configured sink, namespace and observer position before changing filters.

evals.name: remove-keyed-child
evals.prompt: Remove a line from one order with two lines of the same display name.
assertions: Does not identify lines by display name.
Identifies parent and child by independent keys.
Verifies the sibling and parent survive replay.
